title: Two Directions on a Letter Ring
statement:
# Two Directions on a Letter Ring

Given a nonempty string S, determine whether there exists a string V such that rotating V left once produces S and rotating V right once also produces S.

Input: a single nonempty string S using letters a, b, c (length up to 100000).

Output YES or NO.

Example: input `abab`, output `YES`.

model.objective: Determine whether a valid V exists

reference_solution: Check S[i] == S[(i+2)%N] for each i; output YES iff all pass. Time O(N), extra space O(1).
proof: L(V)=S determines V uniquely as R(S). Substituting this into R(V)=S gives R(R(S))=S, equivalent to every cyclic position matching the one two positions ahead. The condition is therefore necessary and sufficient.
